references.text: Eliab son of Helon is first mentioned here as the leader of the tribe of Zebulun in the census.
Eliab son of Helon is the prince over the sons of Zebulun and leads their military division in the camp.
Eliab son of Helon leads the army of the children of Zebulun during the wilderness journey.
Zebulun was Jacob's sixth son with Leah, and the tribe of Zebulun descends from him.
Jacob's blessing over Zebulun, the ancestor of the tribe that Eliab represents.
